allowance.name: allowance
allowance.description: Money a member may spend from their organisation, up to a limit each month.

api-key.name: api-key
api-key.description: A key an agent or a service calls with, on behalf of whoever created it. Better Auth keeps its hash.

invitation.name: invitation
invitation.description: An offer to join an organisation, sent to an email address.

membership.name: membership
membership.description: A person's place in an organisation.

organization.name: organization
organization.description: A company whose owner hands out allowances, up to a cap each.

person.name: person
person.description: Someone who signs in. Better Auth keeps people; the project refers to them by id.

session.name: session
session.description: A person's signed-in session, issued by Better Auth.

allowance.get.name: allowance.get
allowance.get.description: Read one allowance by its id: organization, member, limit, spent, state.

allowance.grant.name: allowance.grant
allowance.grant.description: Let a member spend from the organisation, up to a limit each month.

allowance.revoke.name: allowance.revoke
allowance.revoke.description: Stop an allowance. Nothing more can be spent from it.

allowance.spend.name: allowance.spend
allowance.spend.description: Spend from what is left of this month's allowance.

api-key.create.name: api-key.create
api-key.create.description: Create an API key in an organisation. The key itself is shown once.

invitation.accept.name: invitation.accept
invitation.accept.description: Accept an invitation and become a member of its organisation.

invitation.revoke.name: invitation.revoke
invitation.revoke.description: Withdraw an invitation that hasn't been accepted.

invitation.send.name: invitation.send
invitation.send.description: Invite someone to an organisation by email.

membership.get.name: membership.get
membership.get.description: Read one membership by its id: organization, person, role.

organization.create.name: organization.create
organization.create.description: Found an organisation with its cap. Whoever founds it owns it, and is its first member.

organization.get.name: organization.get
organization.get.description: Read one organization by its id: name, owner, state.

person.sign-up.name: person.sign-up
person.sign-up.description: Sign up with an email address and a password.

session.sign-in.name: session.sign-in
session.sign-in.description: Sign in with email and password. The token is the bearer for every later call.
